title: Bug:Setting ring_thread_enabled to true in DEVICE_METADATA causes orchagent to fail during startup.
author: aeedara-nokia
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

Setting ring_thread_enabled to true in DEVICE_METADATA causes orchagent to fail during startup. The failure is due to an invalid command-line invocation, where the -R option is passed without a required argument.           

Set the following in config_db.json:
"ring_thread_enabled": "true"

Restart swss or reboot the device:
sudo systemctl restart swss
Observe that orchagent does not start.

/usr/bin/orchagent -d /var/log/swss -b 1024 -s \
  -m a8:24:b8:8b:45:0d -q tcp://127.0.0.1 -R &
Observed Behavior
orchagent exits immediately with the following error:

/usr/bin/orchagent: option requires an argument -- 'R'
This indicates that the -R option is being passed without a required value.                                            




### Steps to Reproduce

Set the following in config_db.json:
"ring_thread_enabled": "true"

Restart swss or reboot the device:
sudo systemctl restart swss
Observe that orchagent does not start.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

When ring_thread_enabled=true, orchagent should:

Start successfully, or

Validate required parameters and fall back safely if missing.

-R must not be passed without its mandatory argument.

### Relevant log output

```shell
/usr/bin/orchagent -d /var/log/swss -b 1024 -s -m a8:24:b8:8b:45:0d -q tcp://127.0.0.1 -R &
[1] 276
root@ixr-x1b-2:/# /usr/bin/orchagent: option requires an argument -- 'R'
 
[1]+  Exit 1                  /usr/bin/orchagent -d /var/log/swss -b 1024 -s -m a8:24:b8:8b:45:0d -q tcp://127.0.0.1 -R
```

### Output of `show version`, `show techsupport`

```shell
SONiC Software Version: SONiC.nokia-master.0-dirty-20260202.102116
SONiC OS Version: 13
Distribution: Debian 13.3
Kernel: 6.12.41+deb13-sonic-arm64
Build commit: cfc90a838
Build date: Mon Feb  2 15:22:47 UTC 2026
```

### Attach files (if any)

_No response_

comments.author: Chiranjeevi-U-ML
comments.body:
Hi Aeedara,

In line 403 of `src/sonic-swss/orchagent/main.cpp`, the **-R** option is defined as a flag (means there's no argument required).

but the "-R" option was being added without a trailing space in the `dockers/docker-orchagent/orchagent.sh` at line 127. So, when the script builds the command line arguments, it might be concatenating them.

Try adding a trailing space as such in the same line: 
`ORCHAGENT_ARGS+="-R "`


For ref, the VS image doesn't face this issue because it has the trailing space in platform/vs/docker-sonic-vs/orchagent.sh at line 62

> ORCHDAEMON_RING_ENABLED=`sonic-db-cli CONFIG_DB hget "DEVICE_METADATA|localhost" "ring_thread_enabled"`
> if [[ x"${ORCHDAEMON_RING_ENABLED}" == x"true" ]]; then
>    ORCHAGENT_ARGS+="-R "
> fi

please let me know if this fixed the issue

comments.author: vpandian-nokia
comments.body:
Hi Chiranjeevi,

We tried your suggestion and it doesn't work.

"/usr/bin/orchagent -d /var/log/swss -b 1024 -s -m a8:24:b8:8b:45:0d -q tcp://127.0.0.1 -R  "
/usr/bin/orchagent: option requires an argument -- 'R'

It is expecting some character after the <space>

This is also what is in /usr/bin/orchagent.sh

# Enable ring buffer
ORCHDAEMON_RING_ENABLED=`sonic-db-cli CONFIG_DB hget "DEVICE_METADATA|localhost" "ring_thread_enabled"`
if [[ x"${ORCHDAEMON_RING_ENABLED}" == x"true" ]]; then
    ORCHAGENT_ARGS+=" -R "
fi

comments.author: Chiranjeevi-U-ML
comments.body:
Hi Pandian,

I'm sorry for the confusion caused by my earlier comment suggesting that adding a trailing space to `-R` in `orchagent.sh` would fix this issue. 

I went through the code files and the original commits and was able to find the root cause. The bug was not in the shell script, and it's in the `getopt` string in `main.cpp` file.

Remove the colon beside the `R` in the main.cpp file at line 403. It should be `:RD:` instead of `:R:D:`.

I will raise a PR with this issue highlighting the cause of the issue and the justification.

Please let me know if the fix is working fine or not, in the meantime.

Thanks :)

linkedPullRequests.title: [orchagent] Fix getopt string for -R option (ring_thread_enabled regression)
linkedPullRequests.author: Chiranjeevi-U-ML
linkedPullRequests.body:

3. Make sure your commit message contains enough details about the change and related tests
4. Make sure your pull request adds related reviewers, asignees, labels

Please also provide the following information in this pull request:
-->

**What I did**
Fixed a typo in the getopt option string in `orchagent/main.cpp` where the `-R` option was incorrectly defined as requiring a mandatory argument (`R:`) instead of being a simple flag (`R`).

The fix changes line 403 from:
```cpp
while ((opt = getopt(argc, argv, "b:m:r:f:j:d:i:hsz:k:q:c:t:v:I:R:D:M")) != -1)
```
to:
```cpp
while ((opt = getopt(argc, argv, "b:m:r:f:j:d:i:hsz:k:q:c:t:v:I:RD:M")) != -1)
```


**Why I did it**

When ring_thread_enabled is set to true in DEVICE_METADATA, orchagent fails to start with the error:
`/usr/bin/orchagent: option requires an argument -- 'R'`

This bug was introduced in PR #3814 (specifically, commit 5de59222) when the -D option was added. 

The getopt string was changed from `I:R` to `I:R:D:` instead of the correct `I:RD:`. 

This accidentally added a colon after R, making it require a mandatory argument.


**How I verified it**

I did a code review and verified that the -R case handler does not use `optarg` and simply sets `gRingMode = true`. Also, I have checked the git history and traced the bug introduction to PR #3814 and confirmed the original implementation in PR #3242 was correct.

Check the code lines here:

Original PR link:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/pull/3242/changes#diff-3cba33a216c0ea2b942dc03b2638fa27a40a8b6eb81abf9f83f13e1ee7831ac4R360

Bug Link:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/pull/3814/changes#diff-3cba33a216c0ea2b942dc03b2638fa27a40a8b6eb81abf9f83f13e1ee7831ac4R373


**Details if related**

Fixes: sonic-net/sonic-buildimage#25366
